component.name: Raven Camera
component.summary: Photos, video, screenshots and screen recording

description.p: Raven Camera takes photos and records video from the built-in camera or any USB webcam, takes screenshots, and records the screen, a single window or a region of it, with system sound, the microphone, and an optional webcam overlay.
Recordings are captured losslessly and saved as MP4 (H.264 and AAC) or M4A, using Raven Linux's own encoders.
